headline: Replay tool is live on main; the free lane probes the board and exits clean
lede: FEEDBACKREPLAY merged while slot a was claiming its target: point it at any filed feedback report and it re-drives the last 30 seconds of play on the live game. With that stage in, slot b holds #737's remaining legs — Jon's phone reports plus one Chrome-capable replay — and the builder ladder came back empty for the second kick in an hour.

notes.text: #737's last builder stage merged as 6d2873c (PR #1466, slot b): scripts/feedbackreplay.mjs extracts a replay stream from a filed issue and re-drives it with real key events on the dev server. #737 stays open — its Done bar now needs Jon's three phone reports and one live replay, neither of which is builder work.

Self-commission is exhausted: game-queue/next/steer empty, open feedback is owned by a live QA lane, and every honest gap in all four flagship READMEs (SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD, Myst) is CLOSED. idle.mjs returns null, twice-confirmed by two lanes 30 minutes apart. The studio needs Jon to queue the next game (#1456, deadline 11-04).

Slot a's targeted claim on #737 was refused by the liveness lock (b merged minutes later — the lock did its job). Next lane: b's lock expires 22:17Z only if b goes silent; do not claim #737 for bookkeeping, the leftover work is human/browser-tier.
